title.target: bǐjiān huà bù chū de lǜ
title.english: The Green His Pen Couldn’t Draw

pairs.target: shíjiē zǒu jìn , lùshang yǒu yì jié mànshuǐ , liǎng rén cǎi guòqù , xiédǐ dōu shītòu le .
pairs.english: At the end of the steps, water covered a stretch of road; they walked through it and soaked their soles.
pairs.hanzi: 石阶走尽，路上有一截漫水，两人踩过去，鞋底都湿透了。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ zǒu dào nánpō yìzhàn shí , tǎ wéi xiān wénjiàn chǎo zǐ de xiāngqì , cái kànjiàn ménqián nà miàn tuì le sè de qí .
pairs.english: When he reached the south-slope post station that afternoon, Tavi first smelled the fragrance of roasted seeds and only then saw the faded flag outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 下午走到南坡驿站时，塔维先闻见炒籽的香气，才看见门前那面褪了色的旗。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi yìzhàn zhǐguǎn huànmǎ sòngxìn , yuànlǐ què lián shài xié de dìfāng dōu kuàijǐ méi le , qiánggēn zuò zhe rén , jiǎo páng fàng zhe chāixiàlái de chē bǎn .
pairs.english: He had thought post stations merely changed horses and sent letters, but the yard barely had space left even to dry shoes; people sat by the wall with removed cart boards at their feet.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为驿站只管换马送信，院里却连晒鞋的地方都快挤没了，墙根坐着人，脚旁放着拆下来的车板。

pairs.target: cén shū de chē xiān dào le , kōng kuāng yǐjīng xièxià , tā zhèng gēn huǒjì shuōhuà , jiàn liǎng rén jìnmén , biàn jǔ le jǔ biān bǐng , suànshì zhāohū .
pairs.english: Uncle Cen’s cart had arrived first and the empty baskets were already unloaded; he was talking to a worker, saw them enter, then raised his whip handle in greeting.
pairs.hanzi: 岑叔的车先到了，空筐已经卸下，他正跟伙计说话，见两人进门，便举了举鞭柄，算是招呼。

pairs.target: tā de kuāng yào huàn shéng , bùnéng lìkè huíchéng , dàn tā shuōmíng rì de huó lìng yǒu ānpái , bìng méi kāikǒu yào shuí tì tā děng .
pairs.english: His baskets needed new ropes, so he could not return immediately, but he said tomorrow’s work was arranged separately and did not ask anyone to wait for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他的筐要换绳，不能立刻回城，但他说明日的活另有安排，并没开口要谁替他等。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài guìtái bào le liǎng rén de míngzì , shuōmíng tǎ wéi shì xuégōng chūlái zuò jìlù de xuéshēng , chī zhù xiān jì zài tā nà bǐlù zhàng shàng .
pairs.english: Nerai gave both their names at the counter, explaining Tavi was an academy student out taking records; his board and lodging should go on her travel account for now.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在柜台报了两人的名字，说明塔维是学宫出来做记录的学生，吃住先记在她那笔路账上。

pairs.target: huǒjì lǐng tāmen kànguò pùwèi , jiào tāmen bǎ shī xié gē zài yánxià , bié bǎ lóubǎn yě dài zhe zǒu yílù ní .
pairs.english: The worker showed them their beds and told them to leave wet shoes under the eaves rather than drag a whole road's mud across the floorboards too.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计领他们看过铺位，叫他们把湿鞋搁在檐下，别把楼板也带着走一路泥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bāofàng hǎo , xiàlóu qǔshuǐ , zhèng pèngjiàn yígè nǚrén bào zhe juànchǐ cóng yuànlǐ jìnlái , xiùkǒu mó de fābái .
pairs.english: Tavi put his pack away and went downstairs for water, where he happened to meet a woman coming in from the yard with a coiled measuring tape, her cuffs worn white.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把包放好，下楼取水，正碰见一个女人抱着卷尺从院里进来，袖口磨得发白。

pairs.target: huǒjì shuō zhè shì gāng lái de xuégōng xuéshēng , tā biàn wèn shìbushì bái jiē lái de , suíjí shuō zìjǐ jiào dù yīng , zài nàér niànshū yǐjīng shì shí lái niánqián de shì .
pairs.english: The worker said this was the newly arrived academy student; she asked whether he came from White Steps, then said she was named Du Ying and had already studied there over ten years ago.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计说这是刚来的学宫学生，她便问是不是白阶来的，随即说自己叫杜缨，在那儿念书已经是十来年前的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shuǐhú nuó dào zhuō jiǎo , gěi tā ràng gè zuò chù , tā bǎ juànchǐ héng zài xī shàng , xiān wèn jīn zǎo xiàshān de lù shìbushì yòu diào shítou .
pairs.english: Tavi moved the kettle to a table corner to make room for her; she laid the measuring tape across her knees and first asked whether stones had fallen again on the road down that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把水壶挪到桌角，给她让个坐处，她把卷尺横在膝上，先问今早下山的路是不是又掉石头。

pairs.target: tā shuō míngbái le nà yíkuài yǒu duō dà , nuó dào nǎlǐ , méiyǒu bǎ hòulái nàtiáo shíjiē lù yě suànzàilǐmiàn .
pairs.english: He explained the stone's size and where they had moved it, without including the later stretch of stone steps in his account.
pairs.hanzi: 他说明白了那一块有多大、挪到哪里，没有把后来那条石阶路也算在里面。

pairs.target: dù yīng tīng wán diǎntóu , shuō zìjǐ míngrì qù kàn zhè duàn hùlán , búshì zhèhuìer ná juànchǐ jiù néng bǎ suǒyǒu lù dōu liángwán .
pairs.english: Du Ying nodded after listening, saying she would inspect that section of railing tomorrow, not that having a tape in hand now meant she could measure every road at once.
pairs.hanzi: 杜缨听完点头，说自己明日去看这段护栏，不是这会儿拿卷尺就能把所有路都量完。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ yǒurén tīngjiàn , duān zhe wǎn jiù chāhuà , shuō tāmen zhǐ kěn xiū shānmén wǎng shàng de , xià tóu nàduàn yào yìzhí děngdào méi rén gǎn zǒu cái suàn huài me .
pairs.english: Someone in the yard heard and interrupted, bowl in hand, saying they would only repair uphill from the mountain gate: must the lower stretch wait until nobody dared walk there before it counted as damaged?
pairs.hanzi: 院里有人听见，端着碗就插话，说她们只肯修山门往上的，下头那段要一直等到没人敢走才算坏么。

pairs.target: shuōhuà de shì gè yùn mùliào de nánrén , wǎn biān yǒu dào kē kǒu , shǒushàng zhān de shùpí hái méi kōu gānjìng .
pairs.english: The speaker was a man hauling timber, with a chip on his bowl’s rim; bits of bark still clung to his hands, not yet picked off.
pairs.hanzi: 说话的是个运木料的男人，碗边有道磕口，手上沾的树皮还没抠干净。

pairs.target: dù yīng méi shuō tā chǎo , zhǐ wèn tā zuórì dìgěi yìzhàn de nà zhāng dān shàng , xiě de shì hùlán háishì zhěngduàn tā pō .
pairs.english: Du Ying did not accuse him of being noisy, only asked whether yesterday's request submitted to the post station named a railing or an entire collapsed slope.
pairs.hanzi: 杜缨没说他吵，只问他昨日递给驿站的那张单上，写的是护栏还是整段塌坡。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō hùlán yě yào , pō yě yào , nándào tián yìzhāng zhǐ jiù zhǐnéng huài yíyàng .
pairs.english: The man said he wanted the railing too, and wanted the slope too: did filling one sheet mean only one thing could be broken?
pairs.hanzi: 男人说护栏也要，坡也要，难道填一张纸就只能坏一样。

pairs.target: pángbiān jǐgè rén xiào le , dù yīng què méi xiào , shuō liǎngyàng yào dài de rén hé cáiliào bùtóng , míngzǎo de chē zhǐyǒu bǔ lán de liào .
pairs.english: Some people nearby laughed, but Du Ying did not; the two repairs needed different people and materials, she said, and tomorrow morning's cart carried only railing supplies.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边几个人笑了，杜缨却没笑，说两样要带的人和材料不同，明早的车只有补栏的料。

pairs.target: " tóng jiē chū de nà bǐ qián , zhǐ rèn dào shānmén . "
pairs.english: “That money Copperstep provided only reaches the mountain gate.”
pairs.hanzi: “铜阶出的那笔钱，只认到山门。”

pairs.target: nánrén bǎ wǎn wǎng shǒulǐ yì tái , shuō mùtou guò shānmén shí , chénglǐ yòu méi shuō zhǐyào lǐtou zhǎng de .
pairs.english: The man lifted the bowl in his hand, saying that when timber crossed the mountain gate, the city never said it wanted only wood grown on the inside.
pairs.hanzi: 男人把碗往手里一抬，说木头过山门时，城里又没说只要里头长的。

pairs.target: dù yīng shuō zhè jù ràng tā liú zhe , hòu rì xiūlù huì de rén dào , zìjǐ huì bǎ tā de dān hé zhè jù huà yìqí bǎi shàngzhuō , bú tì nǎbiān gǎi de hǎotīng .
pairs.english: Du Ying said he should keep that remark: people from the road association would arrive the day after tomorrow, and she would put both his request and these words on the table without sweetening either side’s case.
pairs.hanzi: 杜缨说这句让他留着，后日修路会的人到，自己会把他的单和这句话一齐摆上桌，不替哪边改得好听。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì cóng hòutou chūlái , jiào liǎng rén xiān chī , shuōhuà búshì zào shàng de chái , bié bǎ zhěngguō fàn dōu děng liáng le .
pairs.english: The innkeeper came out from the back and told them to eat first: talk was not fuel for the stove, and they should not let the whole pot of food go completely cold while waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜从后头出来，叫两人先吃，说话不是灶上的柴，别把整锅饭都等凉了。

pairs.target: nánrén méiyǒu zǒu , wǎng dù yīng nà zhāng zhuōzi bān le zhāng dèngzi , zuòxià shí hái bǎ juànchǐ wǎng pángbiān nuó , pà wǎndǐ zhān shàngqù .
pairs.english: The man stayed and carried a stool to Du Ying's table; sitting down, he moved the measuring tape aside too, afraid the bowl's base might stain it.
pairs.hanzi: 男人没有走，往杜缨那张桌子搬了张凳子，坐下时还把卷尺往旁边挪，怕碗底沾上去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chóngxīn tíqǐ shuǐhú , zhàn zài lóutī biān , guò le yíhuìer , cái fāxiànzìjǐ dǎngzhù le huǒjì shōu wǎn de lù .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up his kettle again and stood by the stairs; after a while, only then did he realize he was blocking the worker’s path as he collected bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维重新提起水壶，站在楼梯边，过了一会儿，才发现自己挡住了伙计收碗的路。

pairs.target: tā máng ràngkāi , nài lěi zài ménkǒu zhāoshǒu , jiào tā qù kànkàn yuàn wài nàge mài chǎo zǐ de xiǎotān , zìjǐ xiǎng chī , bùxiǎng zài cháng zuówǎn nàyàng de xián dòu .
pairs.english: He hurried aside; Nerai waved from the door and asked him to look at the roasted-seed stall outside, saying she wanted some and did not want another taste of salty beans like last night’s.
pairs.hanzi: 他忙让开，奈蕾在门口招手，叫他去看看院外那个卖炒籽的小摊，自己想吃，不想再尝昨晚那样的咸豆。

pairs.target: " nà dōu wǔtiān qián le . "
pairs.english: “That was five days ago already.”
pairs.hanzi: “那都五天前了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōwán , liǎng rén dōu xiào qǐlái , tā tāochū yìwén , mǎi le xiǎoxiǎo yì zhǐbāo , méi bǎ zhùdiàn de fànqián yě suànzàilǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi said it and they both laughed; he took out one copper and bought a tiny paper packet, without counting the inn’s meals as part of it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说完，两人都笑起来，他掏出一文，买了小小一纸包，没把住店的饭钱也算在里面。

pairs.target: chī guò wǎnfàn , yuànlǐ de zhēnglùn hái duànduànxùxù , cén shū yǐjīng gǎnchē shàng le huíchéng de lù , méi gēn tāmen zhù xià .
pairs.english: After supper, the argument still came and went in the yard; Uncle Cen had already driven onto the road back to town and did not stay with them.
pairs.hanzi: 吃过晚饭，院里的争论还断断续续，岑叔已经赶车上了回城的路，没跟他们住下。

pairs.target: nài lěi dài tǎ wéi zǒu dào yánxià de lán biān , jiào tā xiān bié dīng zhe yuǎnchù , kànkàn xià tóu nà kuài báitiān huīpūpū de shíbì .
pairs.english: Nerai led Tavi to the railing beneath the eaves, asking him not to stare into the distance yet but to look at the rock face below that had been dull grey by day.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾带塔维走到檐下的栏边，叫他先别盯着远处，看看下头那块白天灰扑扑的石壁。

pairs.target: tā kàn le bàntiān , cái fāxiàn shífèng biān yǒuxiē wēiruò de lǜ diǎn , liàng yíchù , àn yíchù , bù liánchéng lù , yě bú xiàng rénjiā diǎn de dēng .
pairs.english: After a long look, only then did he notice some faint green dots beside the cracks, some bright and some dim; they formed no road and looked nothing like household lamps.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了半天，才发现石缝边有些微弱的绿点，亮一处，暗一处，不连成路，也不像人家点的灯。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zhèbiān jiào yè tái , tiānhēi huì liàng yìdiǎn , zhào bù qīng jiǎoxià , zhēn zǒulù hái děi zìjǐ dài dēng .
pairs.english: Nerai said locals called it nightmoss: it glowed a little after dark but could not light the ground underfoot, so anyone actually walking still had to bring their own lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说这边叫夜苔，天黑会亮一点，照不清脚下，真走路还得自己带灯。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ chǎo zǐ bāo wàng zài shǒulǐ , lǜ diǎn yuè kàn yuè duō , xiàng gāngcái hái jǐ zài yuànlǐ de shìjiè , hūrán yòu cháo ànchù shēnchū qù yì jié .
pairs.english: Tavi forgot the seed packet in his hand; green dots multiplied the longer he looked, as if the world that had still been crammed into the yard a moment ago had suddenly stretched again a little farther into the dark.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把炒籽包忘在手里，绿点越看越多，像刚才还挤在院里的世界，忽然又朝暗处伸出去一截。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā shìbushì měi huí dōu dài xīnshǒu láikàn .
pairs.english: He asked whether she brought beginners to see it every time.
pairs.hanzi: 他问她是不是每回都带新手来看。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zìjǐ tóuyìhuí zài zhèér zhù , zuò dào tāng liáng le yě méi shànglóu , zhǎngguì hái yǐwéi tā bù xǐhuan hē .
pairs.english: Nerai said on her first stay here she sat until her soup went cold without going upstairs; the innkeeper had thought she did not like drinking it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说自己头一回在这儿住，坐到汤凉了也没上楼，掌柜还以为她不喜欢喝。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe xiào , xiǎng wèn tā nà shíhòu duō dà , yuànlǐ què yǒurén jiào tā , tā yìng le yìshēng , xiānhuíqù shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed as he listened, wanting to ask how old she had been then, but someone called her from the yard; she answered and went back to talk first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着笑，想问她那时候多大，院里却有人叫她，她应了一声，先回去说话。

pairs.target: tā liúzài lán biān , guò le huìer cái huíwū , diǎnliàng xiǎo dēng , zài zìjǐ de cèzi shàng jìxià dìyīyè zhù zài nánpō .
pairs.english: He stayed by the railing a while before returning to his room, lit a little lamp, and wrote in his own notebook that his first night was at South Slope.
pairs.hanzi: 他留在栏边，过了会儿才回屋，点亮小灯，在自己的册子上记下第一夜住在南坡。

pairs.target: xiě wán lù hé shíchén , tā lìng fān yíyè , xiǎng huà nà diǎn lǜ , bǐjiān luòxià què zhǐ shèng yìtuán hēi .
pairs.english: After writing the route and time, he turned to another page to draw that green; the pen tip came down, but only a blot of black remained.
pairs.hanzi: 写完路和时辰，他另翻一页，想画那点绿，笔尖落下却只剩一团黑。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe nà tuán hēi , zhōngyú zài pángbiān xiě : zhège děi děng huíqù , yòng zuǐjiǎng .
pairs.english: Looking at the black blot, he finally wrote beside it: this one must wait until he got back, to be told aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着那团黑，终于在旁边写：这个得等回去，用嘴讲。
